doc: tasks/find on 10^5 task entities (titles and bodies in the full-text index) seeded into a running hub's schema-7 store: a word 1,000 entities hold (the first page of 50 of 1,000 ranked hits) and a word one entity holds, 20 samples each (--perf records every sample, no budget).

sql: insert into entity (n, id, kind, title, status, origin, ver, created_tx, updated_tx) with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 100000) select i, 'task:p' || i, 'task', 'task t' || i || ' alpha' || (i % 100), 'open', 'recorded', 1, 1, 1 from c

insert into entity_fts (rowid, title, body) with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i + 1 from c where i < 100000) select i, 'task t' || i || ' alpha' || (i % 100), 'body text number' || i from c
